workload.test_selection: every tenth train record, starting at zero

measurement.time: perf_counter around inspect_jsonl including storage observation and cleanup; excludes interpreter startup and input generation
measurement.memory: Linux process-lifetime ru_maxrss in bytes; includes interpreter and imports
measurement.io: Linux RUSAGE_SELF ru_inblock/ru_oublock deltas around inspect_jsonl including storage observation and cleanup; filesystem operation counters, not bytes or syscall counts
measurement.storage: single snapshot after successful scan before close/rollback; main page_count * page_size includes buffered pages; file_bytes is stat size and allocated_bytes is st_blocks * 512 for main database and existing journal/wal/shm; excludes directories and other SQLite temporary files; no commit/flush; not peak or physical-device usage; null for memory backend or unavailable allocation counts; Python tempfile filesystem uncharacterized
measurement.order: alternating first backend; fresh process per run; no cache flushing
